SQL.Strings: select c.ID, c.Name, c.INN, c.Open_Dat, c.Close_Dat, c.Cust_TYPE, c.op_id,
(select name from prinad where id=c.prinad_kod) as prinad,
(SELECT name FROM qrp_klie where id=c.group_klie) as group_klie,
(SELECT name FROM vid_sob where id=c.vid_sob) as vid_sob,
(SELECT name FROM org_prav where id=c.org_sob) as org_sob,
(SELECT name FROM sferadey where id=c.sfera_dey) as sfera_dey,
(SELECT name FROM otrasli where id=c.otrasl) as otrasl,
(SELECT name FROM nalog where id=c.nalog_kod) as nalog_kod,
(select cntr_name from countries where id=ci.citizenship)as cntr_name,
(SELECT name FROM categories where id= c.category) as category,
c.address, c.city, c.country_code, c.director_id, c.email, c.url,
(select name from user$ where id=c.op_id) as USER_NAME,
(select filialid from sba_objinf where obj=(select name from user$ where id=c.op_id)) filial_id,
(select name from filial_t where id=(select filialid from sba_objinf where obj=(select name from user$ where id=c.op_id))) filial_name
and c.ID in (select KLI_ID from Account where Filial =0) and
c.close_dat is null and (c.open_dat between (:BegDate) and (:EndDate))
Select min(C.open_dat) as CMinDate,max(C.open_dat) as CMaxDate,
ac.tipacc as symbol, f.Name as Filial, cu.name as cust_name,ac.bal_cn1,cu.inn as cust_voen,ct.name as cust_type
from Account ac, Avalute val, ArchOst ten, Filial f, customers cu, cust_types ct
and (ac.name like:pName) and f.id=ac.filial and cu.id=ac.kli_id and ct.id=cu.cust_type
p.dat,a1.acc_no as Debit,a1.Name as DName,a2.acc_no as Credit,a2.Name as CName,
p.ammount,p.lammount,p.ammount_c,p.name, a1.tipacc as d_symbol,a2.tipacc as c_symbol
from provarch p, account a1, account a2
and (p.debt in (select id from account where acc_no=:Acc_NO)
or p.kredit in (select id from account where acc_no=:Acc_NO))
